name: minecraft-afk-bot
description: Self-healing Minecraft AFK bot with an honest dashboard: probe-gated reconnects, watchdogs, single-instance lease, policy-ban handling and optional provider/serverless support.

scripts.repair: rm -rf node_modules && npm ci --omit=dev || npm install --omit=dev
scripts.test: node --check doctor.js && node --check index.js && node --check probe.js && node --check watcher.js && node --check provider.js && node --check leaveRejoin.js && node --check logger.js
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:lifecycle && npm run test:duplicate-instance && npm run test:mirror && npm run test:watcher-policy && npm run test:provider && npm run test:proxy && npm run test:keepalive && npm run test:serverless && npm run test:single-host && npm run test:liveness && npm run test:doctor && npm run test:dashboard-auth && npm run test:chat

author: Lamgerr
